# MOTTO Automotive

- Luxury automotive programmes: custom number plate holders and non-registration showroom plates for luxury car brands and UAE dealers. Official registration plates are issued only by the competent authority.

> MOTTO Automotive is a UAE manufacturer of custom car accessories, dealer-branded number plate holders and automotive accessories. The company supports dealers, fleets and mobility partners with product development, manufacturing, finishing, inspection, packaging and recurring supply.

## Important legal distinction

MOTTO Automotive manufactures accessory number plate holders and non-registration showroom display products. It does not issue or reproduce official UAE registration plates. Official plates are issued by competent licensing authorities. A holder must not obscure official plate information. Reference: https://uaelegislation.gov.ae/en/legislations/2598

## Editorial and sourcing policy

Articles are attributed to MOTTO Automotive and link to the company story and editorial context. Technical product guidance is informed by the manufacturing team. Legal articles use official UAE sources, state interpretation limits and are general information rather than legal advice. Final specifications must be confirmed against the current vehicle, approved sample and purchase requirements.
